label: sound
instruction_covers: Do not deactivate a DAG solely because fileloc is outside the configured dags_folder while the processor is still parsing it
Still deactivate a DAG that is actually gone or whose last_parsed_time is older than the stale threshold relative to the file parse
Standalone processor_subdir filtering is existing behavior and is preserved if the folder-path check is removed
notes: The hidden patch deletes test_scan_stale_dags_when_dag_folder_change, which encoded the opposite policy, and retargets the remaining stale-DAG fixtures so commonpath is not the thing under test. Deactivation in test_scan_stale_dags is still the stated threshold case (last_finish_time an hour ahead). The scheduler fileloc=os.devnull line is removed so an outside path does not trip the old check; a correct fix does not need that line. Grading runs the whole two test modules after the patch.
